events.name: Bash
events.head: Locate Stripe/refund code
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git diff --stat cloud/funnel/worker.js; grep -n "hooks/stripe\|hooks/dodo\|refund\|async function refunded\|function refunded" cloud/funnel/worker.js | head -30; grep -n "stripeEnsureCheckout\|enabled_events\|payment_links\|after_completion" cloud/src/connectors/build.ts | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read relevant code
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git diff cloud/funnel/worker.js | head -40; sed -n 878,935p cloud/funnel/worker.js; sed -n 360,400p cloud/src/connectors/build.ts

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find callers and sim handlers
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -rn "stripeEnsureCheckout\|stripeEnsureWebhook\|payment_link_id" cloud/src --include=*.ts | grep -v "export async" | head; grep -n "payment_link_id\|stripe_product\|funnel_id\|k.slug\|k.id\b" cloud/funnel/worker.js | head; grep -n "def stripe\|stripe.*links\|\"/v1/payment_links\|webhook_endpoints\|refund" cloud/scripts/vendor-sim.py | head -30

events.name: Bash
events.head: Callers, sim stripe routes, probes
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -rn "stripeEnsureCheckout\|stripeEnsureWebhook\|payment_link_id" cloud/src | grep -v "export async" | head; sed -n 925,962p cloud/scripts/vendor-sim.py; grep -n "stripe_pay\|/stripe/pay\|stripe/test" cloud/scripts/vendor-sim.py | head; ls cloud/scripts | grep -i "probe.*\(stripe\|refund\|dodo\)"

events.text: Adding Stripe refund handling; checking for an existing refund probe to extend.
